AuthorValue: New bug reports / feature requests arrived; Jordan Matelsky returned in June 2024 to add a CloudVolume-backed link fix and to update CI/Python version support in early 2025.
New contributor Josh Lu resumed work in Oct 2023 with build/CI updates (dockerfile, xquartz), signaling the next generation of lab members picked it back up.
Zhiyi Wu returned in Apr 2023 to add xTB support, and new contributor Jessica Flowers added an ASE engine in mid-2023, driven by external feature requests.
Robert Aboukhalil revived the project in Oct 2019, migrating it to WebAssembly (samtools.wasm, Aioli) and modern npm packaging.
Nezar Abdennur returned in Nov 2021 with major internal refactoring (new query engine, deprecation compatibility) planned during the quiet period.
User-reported issues (Andrea Manica's variance-zero bug, issue #170 for backingfile) triggered fixes in Dec 2023 and Mar 2024.
Julia ecosystem drift (DiffEqBase to SciMLBase, JumpProcesses) required dependency updates starting Jan 2024.
New feature requests around material properties (Issue #106, PR #107) pulled the maintainer back in Dec 2022, alongside external collaborators.
